Class Rorschach

java.lang.Object
gnu.app.Application
gnu.x11.Application
gnu.app.displayhack.DisplayHack

All Implemented Interfaces:

public class Rorschach extends DisplayHack
Simulate ink-blot patterns. It draws random patterns reminiscent of the psychological test of same name.

Modified from rorschach.c in xscreensaver by Jamie Zawinski invalid input: '<'jwz@jwz.org>.
